lines.cn: 秋霜凝结在草地上白茫茫一片，秋虫凄切地鸣叫着
lines.en: Frosty grass gleams gray and pale as crickets chirp softly,

lines.pinyin: cūn nán cūn běi xíng rén jué
lines.cn: 村南村北寂静无声，行人早已绝迹
lines.en: North and south across the village, all footsteps have ceased.

lines.pinyin: dú chū qián mén wàng yě tián
lines.cn: 独自一人走出门外，眺望寂静的田野
lines.en: Stepping out the front gate alone to gaze across open fields,

lines.pinyin: yuè míng qiáo mài huā rú xuě
lines.cn: 皎洁的月光下，开满白花的荞麦田宛如一片白雪
lines.en: Under the radiant moon, buckwheat blooms gleam like snow.
